_comment: Inputs for a shadow-mode run (scripts/srt-review-package/shadow_run.py): prior-period mark + this period's market inputs + (optionally) the human's recorded actual mark to diff against. Shadow mode is READ-ONLY measurement (autonomy ladder L-step 1): the agent estimates the move from the canonical registry + these inputs and reports agreement vs the human. It writes no model and delivers nothing.

recorded_actual._comment: The mark the analyst actually booked this period (from the prior/period evidence). Omit this block until you have it; shadow mode still produces the estimate, just with no agreement diff.
